O.outcome_detail: focus, commitment, and autonomous task completion

cells.quote: The interviewed teachers reported that during the completion of the learning tasks the students of the experimental group were very focused and committed, always showing great care when reading the messages of the corrective and cognitive feedback system.
cells.note: The supplied study excerpt does not include the qualitative-results sentence; the quote is copied from the wiki entry. The entry also reports that control-group students were more dispersed and that some could not finish tasks autonomously.
